independent_computation.step_1_what_the_leaf_asserts: sources[1] is the provenance string backing the second element of the derived cast order for Syndra at 120 Splinters of Wrath. The old string cites Q's damage row and glosses the Dark Sphere as the object E scatters. The new string asserts an ordering dependency: E requires Q2, with Q2 (or E) declared the cc_enabler.
independent_computation.step_2_verify_the_old_string_claim_a: Q 'Dark Sphere' leveling attribute is literally named "Magic Damage": values [90, 125, 160, 195, 230] plus a second modifier [70,70,70,70,70] with units '% AP'. CONFIRMED verbatim in data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[0].leveling.
independent_computation.step_3_verify_the_old_string_claim_b: "the sphere E scatters": E 'Scatter the Weak' effect[1] states "Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units". Q effect[0] states Syndra "conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location ... The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds." So the object E scatters is exactly the Q-conjured Dark Sphere. CONFIRMED.
independent_computation.step_4_test_the_new_string_claim: Is the enabler Q2 (the second Dark Sphere charge) or Q (any Dark Sphere)? Cached wiki text ties E's stun to a pushed Dark Sphere with no charge specificity: E effect[1] "Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds ... and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast"; E effect[2] "...or if the target was hit by a pushed Dark Sphere, after the stun has ended". Neither mentions a charge index.
independent_computation.step_5_the_decisive_gate: Q2 is not a base-kit object. Q effect[1]: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2." Q's own metadata confirms the charge model is splinter-gated: notes = "After Syndra gains the Transcendent bonus, the number of Dark Sphere charges available is represented by small Sphere icons under her health bar". Therefore Q2 exists only at splinters >= 40, while the E-stuns-off-a-sphere coupling exists at 0 splinters. A dependency declared as 'E requires Q2' would make E's CC vanish below 40 splinters, which the cached wiki text contradicts. The minimal and correct enabler is Q (any Dark Sphere on the ground), not Q2.
independent_computation.step_6_no_scarcity_argument_rescues_it: Q notes: "There is no limit as to how many Dark Spheres can be active at a time." Q cooldown/rechargeRate = 7 s flat at all ranks and the sphere persists 6 s, so a single Q charge suffices to have a sphere on the ground for the E push; a second charge is never required for the stun. Casting the second charge also cannot add a second stun to the same target.
independent_computation.step_7_source_pointer_check: The citation tag '.../Syndra@4024662' could not be corroborated from the cached corpus: data/wiki/article-index.json records Syndra with pageid 641379 (plus Syndra/History 1490022, Syndra/Patch history 1484990), and the string '4024662' appears nowhere under data/. This is not by itself proof the revision id is wrong (revision ids are not cached), but the new string's substantive claim is independently falsified by steps 4-6.
independent_computation.step_8_old_string_fits_index_1: The module's slot list for Syndra is [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json: "modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)"), so at 120 splinters a derived order beginning Q, Q2, ... puts a Q-family cast at index 1. Q2's damage row IS Q's 'Magic Damage' row (the Transcendent bonus stocks a charge; it does not restate damage), so "Q 'Magic Damage' - the sphere E scatters" is a correct and sufficient provenance string for that element.

numeric_corroboration.Q_and_Q2_per_cast: 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP) magic damage, identical for both charges (single sourced row).
numeric_corroboration.E_per_cast: 60/95/130/165/200 (+60% AP) magic damage; stun 1.25 s only when a Dark Sphere is pushed into the target.
numeric_corroboration.splinters_120_effect: P effect[2]: "At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%" -> AP multiplier 1.15, applied to every AP ratio above. This scales magnitudes but does not create or remove any Q2 ordering dependency.

independent_computation.conclusion: The correct dependency is E-after-Q (any Dark Sphere). 'E requires Q2' is unsupported by, and inconsistent with, the cached wiki text. The old string makes only claims that verify verbatim against the cached wiki.

sources_quoted.quote: Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.

There is no limit as to how many Dark Spheres can be active at a time. / After Syndra gains the Transcendent bonus, the number of Dark Sphere charges available is represented by small Sphere icons under her health bar, visible to the player only.

Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.

Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% for 1.25 seconds starting after the knock back ends or if the target was hit by a pushed Dark Sphere, after the stun has ended.
At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.

sources_quoted.relevance: The rotation order is a shared-timeline schedule over available casts; nothing in the documented model introduces a charge-index prerequisite, so an ordering edge must be justified by ability text, and the ability text names a Dark Sphere, not a second charge.

verdict_rationale: Every claim in the old string verifies verbatim against the cached wiki (Q's row is named 'Magic Damage' with 90/125/160/195/230 +70% AP; the Dark Sphere is precisely what E scatters). The new string's substantive claim — that E requires Q2 — has no support in the cached wiki and is contradicted by it: Q2 is the 40-splinter Transcendent charge, while E's stun-off-a-pushed-sphere coupling is base kit and is satisfied by any Dark Sphere from the first Q charge. The correct enabler edge is E-after-Q.
caveat: The new string was supplied truncated ('... [source: .../Syndra@4024662]'); the elided quote was not available to this oracle. The verdict rests on the visible dependency claim 'E requires Q2', which is falsifiable and false against the cached corpus regardless of what quote follows. If the intended reading of the token 'Q2' were 'any Dark Sphere' rather than 'the second Dark Sphere charge', the claim would be correct — but the cached audit record defines Q2 explicitly as the synthetic 2nd charge slot.
